title: Dilworth Multiplicity Bounds for the Signless Laplacian and Distance Signless Laplacian of C-Graphs, Threshold Graphs, and Cographs
description: This version studies weighted signless Laplacians on threshold graphs, constructs connected cographs with non-local distance signless Laplacian eigenvalue multiplicity at least one greater than arbitrarily large Dilworth numbers, and enumerates all 1,170 connected cographs of orders two through nine.
